AT THE FOOT · 1:10
NOTES
REVISION 4
The lining is 2 in on the face. The moulding lays 4 in outside it,
all round — so the jambs are 6 in wide, and over the opening the
moulding head sits 6 in ABOVE the leaf rather than on top of it.
That clearance is the whole of the correction in this revision.
The moulding is reeded and turns the corner over the head, so the
reeding runs round the opening in one piece.
Above the moulding, and only above it: a course of scallops, two
small mouldings, and a crown that mitres back at each end.
No corbels, no carving, no blocks at the head.
The crown lands at 2630 (8 ft 8 in), leaving 5 in to the ceiling.
All three doors take the identical casing; only the width changes.
A plinth block takes each jamb down over the marble skirting.
